title: Transfer: Offshore Wind Export Cable Outage
goal: Analyze an offshore wind export network under a normal topology and a maintenance-outage topology, then report export-cable loadings, overloaded elements, landing-point angle shifts, and the cables with the largest rerouted flows.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers dc-power-flow to an offshore grid setting where the key work is still reconstructing B after a cable outage and quantifying how injections reroute across rated corridors.
